data.description: The Webb Telescope is loaded into the cargo hold of the NM Colibri.  The ship sets off for the launch site in Kourou, French Guiana.
data.description_508: Webb's journey to the launch site continues as it's loaded into the NM Colibri and departs for French Guiana
data.photographer: Michael McClare, Sophia Roberts, Michael P. Menzel
data.title: Webb Journey to Space Ep2
